complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Project Setup and Configuration (Java 21 + Spring Boot 3.5.4)
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Expand this task into 9 subtasks. Cover: (1) Gradle init (Groovy DSL), Java 21 toolchain, Spring Boot 3.5.4; (2) Add dependencies listed (web, validation, security, data-jpa, postgresql, flyway, bucket4j, jjwt, argon2, minio, meili, aws sesv2, lombok, springdoc, testcontainers, awaitility); (3) Code quality: Checkstyle or Spotless with Woowa Bros style; (4) application.yml and application-local.yml with env placeholders (DB, MinIO, Meili, SES, JWT, feature flags) and profiles; (5) Flyway baseline V1__init.sql; (6) HealthController GET /health and MockMvc test; (7) Logging config (JSON optional), UTC default, KST handling; (8) Docker Compose for Postgres, MinIO, MeiliSearch, LocalStack SES; (9) Smoke tests for container connectivity and config properties loading. For each subtask, define acceptance criteria, commands to run, and artifacts to commit.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Covers multi-service wiring, build tooling, infra containers, and baseline scaffolding; moderate depth with several moving parts.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Expand into 10 subtasks: (1) Flyway V2__users.sql; (2) JPA entity and repository; (3) DTOs (SignupRequest, LoginRequest, AuthResponse); (4) Argon2id password hashing config and utility; (5) JWT service (HS256, TTL, claims) and key loading from env; (6) Spring Security stateless SecurityFilterChain and JWT auth filter; (7) Bucket4j rate limit for login by IP and username; (8) Controllers for signup/login/logout with validation and uniqueness checks; (9) Integration and unit tests (happy/negative, 401/429, token expiry); (10) Documentation and example curl. Include acceptance criteria and error responses.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Security-critical flows, cryptography, rate limiting, and end-to-end tests increase complexity beyond CRUD.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Password Reset Flow via AWS SES
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Expand into 8 subtasks: (1) Flyway V3__password_reset.sql; (2) Entity, repository, and indices; (3) Token generation utility (SecureRandom Base64URL) and validation rules; (4) SES client configuration and verified sender; (5) Email template and link strategy; (6) Endpoints: password-reset-request and password-reset-confirm with non-disclosing responses; (7) Tests using LocalStack SES or stub, including negative paths (expired, reused, unknown); (8) Observability and security review. Define acceptance criteria and rollback strategy.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Adds token lifecycle, external email integration, careful UX to avoid user enumeration, and robust negative-path handling.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Expand into 9 subtasks: (1) Flyway V4__categories.sql with FKs and indexes; (2) Entity/repository and ownership scopes; (3) Create/list/update/delete endpoints; (4) contentCount aggregation; (5) Sorting by created, updated, custom, and views (SUM view_count) with performance considerations; (6) Reorder endpoint to set order_index by position; (7) Cascade deletion policy and integration with content deletion/MinIO cleanup; (8) Authorization and cross-user isolation; (9) Integration tests covering sorting, counts, reordering, and cascades. Include acceptance criteria and error handling.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Mostly CRUD with non-trivial sorting and cascade semantics plus ownership constraints.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Content CRUD (Photo/Link/Note), MinIO Integration, Tags, View & Pin
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Expand into 14 subtasks: (1) Flyway V5__content_tags.sql (contents, tags, content_tags); (2) Entities, repositories, constraints (unique tag per user); (3) MinIO client and bucket bootstrap; (4) Presigned upload endpoint and key scheme; (5) Download-url endpoint with ownership checks; (6) Create content with type-specific validation; (7) Read/list endpoints with filters, pinned-first ordering, pagination; (8) Update content (fields, move category, tags replace); (9) Delete content with MinIO object deletion and retry/logging; (10) Tag service (create-or-get, set replace, max limits); (11) View count atomic increment; (12) Pin/unpin and bookmarks endpoint; (13) Validation (sizes, content types, tag limits); (14) Integration and concurrency tests with Testcontainers (Postgres+MinIO). Provide acceptance criteria and performance notes.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Broad surface: file storage, presigned URLs, transactional consistency, tagging, counters, and multiple endpoints with validations.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Shareable Links: Generation, Management, and Public Access
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Expand into 10 subtasks: (1) Flyway V6__share_links.sql; (2) Entity/repository; (3) Token generation utility and URL building; (4) Service validations (expiry, download caps, revoke); (5) Auth endpoints: create, list, delete/revoke; (6) Public endpoint /share/{token} with rules and CSP headers; (7) Photo: presigned GET redirect; Note/Link: minimal HTML render and JSON fallback; (8) Atomic increments (download_count and view_count); (9) Error cases: 404/410 for invalid/expired/revoked/maxed; (10) Integration tests and logging/metrics. Include acceptance criteria and security checks.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Public access surface with expiring tokens, limits, redirects/HTML rendering, and counter consistency increases complexity.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Search Integration with MeiliSearch and Outbox Pattern
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Expand into 12 subtasks: (1) Flyway V7__outbox.sql; (2) Outbox entity/repo and helper; (3) Emit outbox events on content create/update/delete and AI updates; (4) Meili index bootstrap and settings (searchable/filterable/sortable attributes); (5) Document mapper (id, userId, categoryId, type, title, body, url, tags, timestamps, view_count); (6) Processor with scheduling, backoff, attempt caps, idempotency; (7) Error handling and DLQ strategy (optional); (8) Search API with user scoping and filters (category, tag, date); (9) Tags usage endpoint; (10) Awaitility-based indexing tests with Meili container; (11) Failure injection tests (Meili down) and retries; (12) Metrics and logs. Define acceptance criteria and performance targets.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Asynchronous consistency, external search service, retries/backoff, and query design push complexity high.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Expand into 9 subtasks: (1) Flyway V8__reminders.sql; (2) Entity/repo with uniqueness and cascade on content delete; (3) Endpoints: create/list/delete with ownership and future-time validation; (4) Scheduler cron in Asia/Seoul and Clock abstraction; (5) SES email composition and sending; (6) Idempotency (sent_at) and retry policy; (7) Mark-reviewed endpoint on content; (8) Integration tests with controllable clock and LocalStack SES; (9) Monitoring/alerts. Include acceptance criteria and timezone correctness checks.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Scheduling with timezone, email delivery, and idempotency introduces concurrency/time concerns beyond simple CRUD.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Expand into 9 subtasks: (1) Flyway V9__stats_daily.sql with unique(user_id,date); (2) Entity/repo and indexes; (3) Nightly scheduler in KST; (4) Aggregation queries (new, total, cumulative views) and upsert; (5) Daily API with range validation; (6) Weekly/monthly APIs aggregating daily rows; (7) Summary API (live DB) with type and category breakdowns; (8) Tests for timezone boundaries and performance; (9) Observability and data backfill script (optional). Define acceptance criteria and SLA for job duration.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Batch aggregation job plus multiple reporting APIs with timezone correctness and performance considerations.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: AI Summarization & Auto-Tagging (Internal + Optional External Fallback)
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Expand into 11 subtasks: (1) AiClient interface and configuration flags; (2) LocalAiClient (summary + keyword tagging with stopwords and limits); (3) OpenAiClient integration with robust JSON parsing, timeouts, retries; (4) Provider selection and fallback logic; (5) Async event listener on content creation (notes/links only); (6) Persistence: update summary and merge tags; (7) Emit outbox UPDATE for search; (8) Manual trigger endpoint; (9) Rate limiting and privacy filters; (10) Unit and integration tests with mocked OpenAI and async flows; (11) Monitoring and safeguards. Include acceptance criteria and failure handling.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Combines NLP heuristics, optional external API, async processing, data updates, and search reindex triggers.
